## Short answer
The passages do not define **“signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope”** as a formal term; they only support treating it as a mapping from high-speed digital / Signal Integrity measurement needs—such as interface validation, eye diagram, impedance, insertion loss, crosstalk, and PDN checks—to the appropriate instrument class, including oscilloscopes where the source explicitly lists “scopes.” [1][2][10][46]
## Supported measurement decisions
| Product-related measurement decision | What the passages support | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Whether an oscilloscope is part of **Interface Test** | Slide 11 maps Interface Test to **scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices**. | [1][2][10] |
| Whether an oscilloscope is part of **Power Distribution Network** measurement | Slide 11 maps **Power Distribution Network** to **scopes and network analyzers**. | [1][2][10] |
| Whether a non-scope instrument is needed for **RefClk / PLL jitter performance** | Slide 11 maps RefClk and PLL jitter performance to **phase noise analyzers and signal generators**, not scopes. | [1][2][10] |
| Whether a non-scope instrument is needed for **ADC / DAC frontend performance** | Slide 11 maps ADC / DAC frontend performance to **spectrum analyzers and signal generators**, not scopes. | [1][2][10] |
| Whether PCB / PCBA Signal Integrity work should focus on **IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, or transmission-line calculation** | Slide 20 is titled **Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA** and lists **IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, TL Calculator**. | [1][2][10][54] |
| Whether PCB test-solution decisions involve **TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, Eye diagram, Delta-L, ISD/ADK, or cable / connector testing** | Slide 21’s **R&S PCB test solutions** for PCB Fabricator and System House lists those flow stages and measurement / analysis items. | [55][58][59] |
| Whether a specific oscilloscope model, option code, bandwidth, fixture, calibration method, or pass/fail condition can be chosen from these passages | The passages explicitly say the sources do **not** provide instrument model, bandwidth, standards, option code, fixture, calibration, or detailed test-condition information for these SI / PCB test mappings. | [11][14][46][48][56] |
## Inference
【推論】Understanding “signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” matters because the supported sources separate oscilloscope-applicable needs such as Interface Test and PDN checks from adjacent SI needs that may point to BERTs, AWGs, network analyzers, phase-noise analyzers, signal generators, spectrum analyzers, VNA / probing / de-embedding, or PCB-flow methods instead. [1][2][4][6][10][13][59]

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Eye opening requirements
| Generation | Extrapolated Eye Height after EQ | Minimum Eye Width after EQ | 來源 | 日期 |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| [[PCIe Gen3]] | 25 mV | 0.3 UI（37.5 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen4]] | 15 ± 1.5 mV | 0.3 UI（18.75 ± 0.55 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen5]] | 15 ± 1.5 mV | 0.3 UI（9.375 ± 0.5 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 minimum eye width 與 eye height 在 post-equalization、3-tap DFE blocks 之前量測。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe redriver output 的 eye opening 需要大於或等於表列 eye opening 數值。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Reference plane 與 vias
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signal trace 從 origination 到 termination 必須全程維持相同 GND reference。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若無法維持相同 GND reference，需 via-stitch 兩個 GND planes，以確保 continuous grounding 與 uniform impedance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 stitching vias 應對稱放置於 signal transition vias 50 mils center-to-center 以內，越近越好。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signals 必須 route over solid reference plane，除非絕對必要，不應跨越 plane split 或 reference plane void。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 TI 不建議 high-speed signal references 使用 power planes。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若完全無法避免 routing over a plane-split，需在 split 兩側放置 stitching capacitors，提供 high-frequency current return path；stitching capacitors 必須為 1 µF 或更低，並盡可能靠近 plane crossing。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 vias 需要 staggered placement；aligned vias 會阻擋 current return path。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）建議 high-speed traces 只放在 top layer 或 bottom layer；若需要 vias，應考慮 back drilling，否則 stub length 可能降低 signal bandwidth。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 via transitions 造成的 stubs 若長於 15 mils，應 back-drill 以降低 insertion losses 並避免 resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe Gen5 20/80% rise/fall time 為 12 ps；為保留 12 ps rise/fall time，需要約 29 GHz bandwidth（0.35/0.12 ns rule）。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說在 29 GHz bandwidth 且使用 Megtron 6（ε 約 3.4）時，quarter wavelength 約 54 mils；若未使用 back drilling，stub 必須小於約 54 mils；對 typical FR4（ε 約 4.2）PCB，maximum stub length 約 51 mils。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Routing quick rules
[[snla426]]（June 2023）列出的 high-speed differential signal quick rules 包括：

- 不可在任何 high-speed differential signal 上放置 probe 或 test points。
- 不可將 high-speed traces route 在 crystals、oscillators、clock signal generators、switching power regulators、mounting holes、magnetic devices、board edge，或使用 / 複製 clock signals 的 ICs 下方或附近。
- BGA breakout 後，high-speed differential signals 應避開 PCIe device，因為 internal state transitions 產生的 high current transients 很難濾除。
- 盡可能將 high-speed differential pair signals route 在 PCB top layer 或 bottom layer，並搭配 adjacent GND layer。
- High-speed differential signals 與 reference plane edge 的距離需 ≥ 5×W 或 5×RPH，取較大者。
- High-speed differential signals 至少需距離 reference plane voids 4×RPH；此規則不適用於 high-speed differential signals 上 SMD pads 的 voiding。
- PCIe device BGA escape 後需維持 constant trace width，以避免 transmission lines 中的 impedance mismatches。
- 為改善 crosstalk，應遵循 ground-signal-ground signal routing，並將所有 high-speed differential pairs 對稱且平行地一起 routing。
- Package escape 與 routing 到 connector pins 時會自然偏離此要求，但 trace deviations 必須盡可能短，否則可能需要 trace width compensation。
- HFSS simulation 可用於最佳化 trace width。
- 多個 high-speed interfaces 的 devices 中，需避免不同 interfaces 間的 crosstalk。
- Package escape 後、connector termination 前，每個 differential pair 不應 route 在另一 differential pair 的 4–5×RPH mils 內。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › PCIe Gen3 到 Gen5 loss budget
| Generation | CPU Package | System Board Trace | CEM Connector | 4” Add-In-Card | Total System Loss | Cross Talk Mitigation | Temp/Humidity Loss | 來源 | 日期 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| [[PCIe Gen3]] | 3.5 dB | 13 dB（9-inch trace with high-loss material） | 0.5 dB | 6.5 dB | 23.5 dB | Negligible | 來源未列數值 | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen4]] | 5 dB | 14 dB（9-inch trace with high-loss material） | 0.5 dB | 8.5 dB | 28 dB | <2 dB | 來源未列數值 | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen5]] | 9.0 dB | 16 dB（9-inch trace with high-loss material） | 1.5 dB | 9.5 dB | 36 dB | 4–5 dB | 2–3 dB | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |

[[snla426]]（June 2023）指出 [[PCIe Gen5]] crosstalk 需要被緩解，且需要納入 total channel loss 考量；Gen5 至少需要比 total system loss 增加 4–5 dB signal strength，以改善 signal-to-noise ratio 並改善目標 BER 1E-12。

- 通訊設備製造商：核心網、5G 基站、光傳輸設備、交換機、路由器等。
- 服務器與資料中心：協助 AI、高效能計算環境部署，需求高速內部連與介面連接。
- 網通基礎建設與雲端應用：包含物聯網、雲計算與邊緣運算等場域皆需高速數據傳輸與處理能力。

- 工業與智慧製造：工業自動化系統、高速資料擷取與辨識也仰賴高速訊號鏈路。

High speed SerDes eco-chain › 上游 — 基礎材料與核心元件
- 半導體晶片：控制器晶片、協定芯片、重驅動 / 重定時（Repeater / Re-timer）、介面協議轉換器等，用於 [[HDMI]]、[[USB]]、[[PCIe]]、[[DisplayPort]] 等高速數位介面。
- 光模組 / 光元件。
- [[PCB]] 印刷電路板材。
- 被動元件。
- 高頻高速連接線材與接頭：同軸 / 雙絞線（twinax）、飛線（Flyover®）、SFP / QSFP 倍率線纜，以及 [[Amphenol]]、[[Molex]]、[[Samtec]]、[[TE]] 提供的背板與板對板連結方案。

## Short answer
The passages do not define **“signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope”** as a formal term; they only support treating it as a mapping from high-speed digital / Signal Integrity measurement needs—such as interface validation, eye diagram, impedance, insertion loss, crosstalk, and PDN checks—to the appropriate instrument class, including oscilloscopes where the source explicitly lists “scopes.” [1][2][10][46]
## Supported measurement decisions
| Product-related measurement decision | What the passages support | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Whether an oscilloscope is part of **Interface Test** | Slide 11 maps Interface Test to **scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices**. | [1][2][10] |
| Whether an oscilloscope is part of **Power Distribution Network** measurement | Slide 11 maps **Power Distribution Network** to **scopes and network analyzers**. | [1][2][10] |
| Whether a non-scope instrument is needed for **RefClk / PLL jitter performance** | Slide 11 maps RefClk and PLL jitter performance to **phase noise analyzers and signal generators**, not scopes. | [1][2][10] |
| Whether a non-scope instrument is needed for **ADC / DAC frontend performance** | Slide 11 maps ADC / DAC frontend performance to **spectrum analyzers and signal generators**, not scopes. | [1][2][10] |
| Whether PCB / PCBA Signal Integrity work should focus on **IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, or transmission-line calculation** | Slide 20 is titled **Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA** and lists **IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, TL Calculator**. | [1][2][10][54] |
| Whether PCB test-solution decisions involve **TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, Eye diagram, Delta-L, ISD/ADK, or cable / connector testing** | Slide 21’s **R&S PCB test solutions** for PCB Fabricator and System House lists those flow stages and measurement / analysis items. | [55][58][59] |
| Whether a specific oscilloscope model, option code, bandwidth, fixture, calibration method, or pass/fail condition can be chosen from these passages | The passages explicitly say the sources do **not** provide instrument model, bandwidth, standards, option code, fixture, calibration, or detailed test-condition information for these SI / PCB test mappings. | [11][14][46][48][56] |
## Inference
【推論】Understanding “signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” matters because the supported sources separate oscilloscope-applicable needs such as Interface Test and PDN checks from adjacent SI needs that may point to BERTs, AWGs, network analyzers, phase-noise analyzers, signal generators, spectrum analyzers, VNA / probing / de-embedding, or PCB-flow methods instead.
